evidence.snippet: Acid mucopolysaccharide secretion by rheumatoid synovial cells and scleroderma fibroblasts was inhibited even at 100 microgram/ml, which is within the therapeutic range
evidence.explanation: Potassium para-aminobenzoate (Potaba), the potassium salt of aminobenzoic acid, directly inhibits fibroblast secretion of acid mucopolysaccharides (glycosaminoglycans).

evidence.snippet: There was a similar dose dependent inhibition of glycosaminoglycan secretion in all 3 groups
evidence.explanation: Potaba (potassium para-aminobenzoate, the potassium salt of aminobenzoic acid) produces dose-dependent inhibition of glycosaminoglycan secretion by skin fibroblasts.

evidence.snippet: Dermal mucin is an amorphous gelatinous substance composed primarily of hyaluronan (HA) and sulphated glycosaminoglycans (GAGs) ... deposition is associated with lupus erythematosus, dermatomyositis, scleroderma and granuloma annulare
evidence.explanation: The dermal mucin deposited in dermatomyositis is composed of hyaluronan and sulphated glycosaminoglycans, and its deposition is associated with dermatomyositis.

evidence.snippet: Mucin deposition is a common feature in autoimmune collagen diseases including dermatomyositis.
evidence.explanation: Glycosaminoglycan-rich dermal mucin deposition is a characteristic feature of dermatomyositis.
